The test suite runs on Node's own type stripping and deliberately has no tsconfig, so nothing here can change what `npm test` measures. rootDir is the repository root and not `src/` because entry points still import their siblings through `../src/...` (src/cli-run.ts:15-16, src/frontier-cli.ts:17-19), which only resolves if the output keeps the `src/` segment. rewriteRelativeImportExtensions turns the `./x.ts` specifiers into `./x.js` on emit, and erasableSyntaxOnly is what makes the source provably equivalent to what Node's stripper would have produced.
